rules: Target CPA on Google search is $80.00. The cut line for a zero-conversion search term is spend at or above the target; the watchlist band is half the target up to the target.

The Brand - Brightside campaign (cmp_102) and any query containing 'brightside' are protected: no negative, pause, bid, or budget change without the owner's written sign-off. A proposal that touches a protected object is a sign-off request, not a change.
Every budget or bidding change is one confirmation each. Negatives go as one reviewed list per confirmation. Nothing is applied without the confirmation.
instructions: Re-read the rules before proposing anything. Numbers come from tool results, never from memory of a previous session.
